name: Joan Miró
contribution: Joan Miró was among the first artists to develop automatic drawing as a way to undo previous established techniques in painting, and thus, with André Masson, represented the beginning of Surrealism as an art movement.
legacy: His work has been interpreted as Surrealist with a personal style, sometimes also veering into Fauvism and Expressionism.

checks.lead: Joan Miró i Ferrà ( mirr-OH, US also  mee-ROH, Catalan: [ʒuˈam miˈɾo j fəˈra]; 20 April 1893 – 25 December 1983) was a Catalan painter, sculptor, and ceramicist from Spain.
